question: Why can admin not delete Calendar (500) in UntisX (endpoint /events)?
answer: Check role admin. Module Calendar may require higher permissions. Error 500: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /events and the database connection. Feature Export must be enabled.
